evals.name: Success & Paginated Envelope Conformance
evals.prompt: Implement an API endpoint returning a paginated list of orders wrapped in the standard response envelope with correlationId and pagination metadata.
evals.expected_output: Returns a response payload matching the standard shape with success: true, data array, pagination object, and meta object.
assertions: Wraps successful list response in standard { success: true, data, pagination, meta } envelope
Includes standard pagination fields (page, pageSize, totalItems, totalPages, hasNextPage, hasPreviousPage)
Injects request correlationId and ISO-8601 timestamp into the meta object
Sets X-Correlation-ID and X-Response-Time operational HTTP response headers

evals.name: Standard Error Code Catalog & Status Code Resolution
evals.prompt: Create an error responder that translates entity not found, validation failures, and duplicate conflicts into standard error codes and matching HTTP status codes.
evals.expected_output: Resolves NOT_FOUND to 404, VALIDATION_ERROR to 400 with details, and CONFLICT to 409 using the standard error envelope.
assertions: Emits error payload with success: false and standard error object
Restricts error code string strictly to the standard 9-code enum catalog
Maps VALIDATION_ERROR to 400, NOT_FOUND to 404, and CONFLICT to 409
Includes structured field-level error details array for validation failures

evals.name: Zero Database Error Leakage & Stack Trace Masking
evals.prompt: Refactor an error handling filter that previously sent raw PostgreSQL error messages and stack traces to clients during database query failures.
evals.expected_output: Logs the complete database error and stack trace server-side, but returns a sanitized INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR or CONFLICT response to the client.
assertions: Completely eliminates raw database error strings and SQL queries from client response body
Suppresses stack traces and internal file paths in production error envelopes
Logs full diagnostic error context server-side alongside the request correlationId
Returns safe, human-readable client message with an RFC-7807 aligned error envelope
